needsYou.productImpact: The remaining ladder to retiring the legacy studio governs nothing until you countersign it — the old plan's ladder stops at M7 and the product kept going.

needsYou.title: Fund the creative-register court
needsYou.productImpact: The first build step of your confirmed focus is a court that renders your cyborg brief eight ways for your eye — it spends real render money, so its price needs your word before any paid arm fires.
needsYou.recommendation: The priced card follows once the court's arms are final; nothing spends until you say so.

needsYou.title: Face-scan pricing: the readout you ordered
needsYou.productImpact: At your own usage intensity, face scanning costs about $1.00/day — roughly $30 per founder-grade user per month, more than a roll's render cost. Full model on issue #38.
needsYou.workedExample: 90 paid scans over 9 days, all yours; a fully-opened roll's scan cost is ~15x the roll's credit value.
needsYou.recommendation: Widen both scan flags together at the current approval-gated population; re-read the distribution before any public widening.

needsYou.title: Turn this page on
needsYou.productImpact: This page replaces the Desk artifact so the briefing survives your account swap. Three things only you can do: run the crew_replies ceremony against production, set CREW_TAB_SCOPE, and make the co-founder's account an admin.
needsYou.workedExample: Then test-drive: open /admin/crew on both themes, reply to a card, and the next shift's push should mark it seen.
needsYou.recommendation: Flip straight to all — the page is already admin-only; the flag exists to keep it dark until your eyes pass it.
